chunks: Surely those who believe and do the right will have gardens of Paradise as gift,
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who believe and do righteous deeds according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual necessity of faith and righteous action for attaining Jannat al-Firdaws, the highest level of Paradise often associated with the Prophet and the Imams. The term 'nuzulan' (a gift/descent) underscores that this reward is a divine bestowal rather than merely a wage, reflecting the concept of divine grace (fadl) alongside justice (adl).
